title: doellingeria umbellata subsp. humilis
intro: Doellingeria umbellata subsp. humilis, commonly known as dwarf wood Aster or low Wood Aster, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce the risk of chronic diseases such as heart disease and cancer. The therapeutic actions of Doellingeria umbellata subsp. humilis include its ability to act as an antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antibacterial agent, which can help to soothe and calm the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
